name: Thought Rune

automation.text: You place a magical effect into the stone used as the spell's material component, creating a visible rune etched into the stone. A creature holding the stone has Advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws.

subclasses: Occultist Monster Hunter, Sanguine Thief Rogue, Spellslinger Gunslinger, Arcane Hand Monk, Arcane Hand Monk
